This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.374/2024 dated 8.11.2024 registered at Police Station Lanji, District Balaghat for the offences punishable under Sections 363,
376, 376(2) (N) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4, 6 of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. The counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

The statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
makes it abundantly clear that the prosecutrix and the applicant were known to each other and they entered into wedlock also.
Later on, when the prosecutrix got pregnant and delivered a child, her parents lodged the present First Information Report against the applicant.

It is submitted that the applicant is in custody since 12.11.2024 NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60645 2 MCRC-52845-2024 and trial would take considerable time to conclude, therefore, the applicant be released on bail.
3.
The counsel for the State has opposed the application.
4 . The counsel for the objector submits that the prosecutrix and the applicant have entered into wedlock and the prosecutrix has no objection to grant bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: 5. Heard the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and perused the case diary.

6. Taking into consideration the totality of the circumstances of the case and no objection expressed by the counsel for the objector, this Court deems it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.
8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
